sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects. Both leverage large-scale speech training data and the strong audio understanding capability of their foundation model, Qwen3-Omni. Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B are ASR models that support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects.
